author: NIN Creative Studio
title: NIN Creative Studio is Hiring Illustrators
content: 🎨 NIN Creative Studio is Hiring! Are you passionate about Illustration and ready to turn creative ideas into compelling artwork? NIN Creative Studio is looking for Illustrator Artists – All Levels to join us on a variety of creative projects, from Characters and Creatures to Environments, Fantasy, and Game Art. Check out the full Job Description here: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4475930253/ Send your CV + Portfolio via LinkedIn or email us at nincreativestudio@gmail.com Subject: Application – Illustrator Artist – [Your Name]

author: The Box, Plymouth
title: Artist Commission for Tides & Tales project
content: OPPORTUNITY CALLOUT: ARTIST COMMISSION 🌊🎙️📦 @take_a_part_uk are looking for an artist-producer (or collective) to lead 'Tides & Tales', a multidisciplinary arts and heritage project... Key Info: 💰 Total Commission: £16,000 (£12,000 artist fee @ £300/day for 40 days + £4,000 materials/production) 📍 Location: East End of Plymouth 🗓️ Delivery Window: November 2026 – March 2027 ⏳ EOI Deadline: Friday 23 October 2026 How to apply: Send your CV, a 2-page outline proposal, and work samples to kim@takeapart.org.uk by 23 October.

author: Baltic Analog Lab
title: Looking for illustrator for new merch
content: We’re looking for a freelance graphic designer (preferably based in Latvia) for occasional collaborations, as well as an illustrator (national or international) to create fun artwork for our new merch! 🦄 Send us a DM with your Instagram account or website. author: Malaka Books
title: Open call for book designers and illustrators
content: FOR BOOK DESIGNERS & ILLUSTRATORS 🗣️ Malaka Books bakal menerbitkan beberapa buku baru. Langsung isi formulir di sini ya 👇 🔗 bit.ly/talentmalakabooks Contact: form at bit.ly/talentmalakabooks
